description: This file defines the DittoLoggerFactory class, a factory utility for creating various types of loggers (DittoLogger, ThreadSafeDittoLogger, DittoDiagnosticLoggingAdapter, ThreadSafeDittoLoggingAdapter) used for logging within the Akka-based system. It encapsulates methods for retrieving loggers by class or name, and for creating logging adapters with MDC support for Akka actors, ensuring consistent and thread-safe logging across the project.

classes.name: DittoLoggerFactory
classes.description: A final utility class providing static factory methods to obtain various types of loggers and logging adapters, primarily for use within an Akka and SLF4J based logging system.

methods.name: getLogger
methods.description: Returns a DittoLogger instance associated with the specified class, using SLF4J LoggerFactory.

methods.name: getLogger
methods.description: Returns a DittoLogger instance with the specified name.

methods.name: getThreadSafeLogger
methods.description: Returns a thread-safe DittoLogger associated with the specified class.

methods.name: getThreadSafeLogger
methods.description: Returns a thread-safe DittoLogger with the specified name.

methods.name: getDiagnosticLoggingAdapter
methods.description: Creates a DiagnosticLoggingAdapter for the provided Akka Actor, supporting MDC.

methods.name: getThreadSafeDittoLoggingAdapter
methods.description: Creates a thread-safe logging adapter with MDC support for the specified Actor.

methods.name: getDiagnosticLoggingAdapterFactory
methods.description: Helper method that creates a supplier to generate DiagnosticLoggingAdapter instances for a given Actor.
